requirements.display_name: W5W 5 W clear wedge-base license plate light bulb

actions.title: Confirm the replacement bulb and let the lamp cool
actions.instruction: Confirm the replacement is a W5W 5 W clear wedge-base bulb. Turn the lights off and do not begin replacement until the existing bulb has cooled.
actions.warning_text: A recently illuminated bulb can be hot enough to cause burns.

actions.title: Remove the license plate light cover
actions.instruction: Wrap the flat-tipped screwdriver tip with protective tape, then remove the license plate light cover without damaging the vehicle finish.

actions.title: Remove the lens and old bulb
actions.instruction: Place the taped flat-tipped screwdriver behind the lens tab and turn it as shown in the owner manual to pry off the lens. Remove the old light bulb.

actions.title: Install the new bulb and restore the lamp
actions.instruction: Install the new W5W 5 W bulb, then reinstall the lens and cover by reversing the removal steps. Fully seat the bulb and the parts used to secure it before finishing.
actions.warning_text: Do not touch the glass portion of the bulb with bare hands. Make sure the bulb and securing parts are fully installed.
